question: how do I enroll in a course how to join a course how to register for a course sign up for course how to start a course how to take a course how to purchase a course

answer: Yes, all courses are self-paced. You can learn on your own schedule and finish faster than the estimated duration if you dedicate more hours per day. Your familiarity with the subject also affects how quickly you complete it.

question: how to save a course for later bookmark a course save course for later how to bookmark a course
answer: The Save for Later option is available for learners enrolled through a sponsored account or learning program. Open the course description page and click Save for Later to bookmark it.

question: how do I re-enroll in a course after subscription expired renew subscription rejoin course how to rejoin expired course how to restart a course after expiry

answer: Go to My Purchases and update your payment to reactivate your subscription. If you are unable to reactivate, open any assignment and click Upgrade to Submit. Then follow the instructions shown on the screen.

question: will my course progress be saved if I pause stop learning take a break will I lose my progress if I stop will progress be saved
answer: Yes, your course progress is automatically saved. You can resume from where you left off at any time after logging back in.

answer: You can enroll in a different course at any time. If you wish to unenroll from a current course, go to My Courses, select the course, and look for the unenroll option in the settings.

answer: Complete all required assignments, quizzes, and graded items in the course. Once you meet the passing criteria, your certificate will be automatically generated and available under My Certificates.

question: I completed the course but did not receive my certificate course finished no certificate missing certificate why did I not get certificate after completing course certificate not generated

For Specialization or Professional Certificate badges, badges are issued every Friday so please wait up to one week. If you still have not received your badge after the waiting period, contact our support team.

question: can I get a certificate if I only audit a course free audit certificate do audit learners get certificate certificate for free course
